name: Four-Archetype Melee
description: Metropolis, five companies, four playbooks. A discounter undercuts on price, an adaptive rival counters every move, a vertical integrator squeezes costs with a farm-to-shelf chain, and a technology leader bets on quality and brand at a premium. Top the brand charts in soft drinks and cars, grind out 18 profitable months in a row, and still be worth $100M when the seven years are up.

goals.description: Reach 70 brand awareness for soft drinks in Metropolis — the volume aisle everyone fights over.
Reach 70 brand awareness for cars in Metropolis — the technology leader's home turf.
Post 18 consecutive months of positive net income — melee survivors earn, they do not just spend.
Be worth at least $100M when the scenario ends in December 2032. This goal is checked at the deadline, so the company has to last the whole melee.
